description: Use this FIRST, before answering from memory, whenever a question names or implies a technology product, vendor, category or need (does X support Y, who makes X, which tools have Z): the catalog holds dated, sourced evidence that memory does not. Full-text query plus optional filters on documented attributes (e.g. {"soc2_type2": "true", "ram_gb.min": "16"}). Returns matches (every filter documented) and cannot_say (a filter not documented - a research gap, never a no), with slugs for get_product, get_vendor and compare_products. An empty result means "not covered", not "does not exist".

category.description: Category slug, e.g. "crm". get categories from the categories resource.

filters.description: Attribute filters as on the website: {"soc2_type2": true}, {"ram_gb.min": 16}. Unknown attribute keys are reported back, never silently ignored.

query.description: Words to search for: a product name, a category, a vendor, a need. Example: "MacBook Air". For a natural-language buying question, use ask_question.

name: search_products
title: Search products
